sentence: This project adapts a data analysis tool to astronomy to reduce false positive planet detections in searches for small planets around distant stars.
This project builds search tools that give biologists fast access to databases of raw DNA and RNA sequencing experiments.
This project studies how a research course that starts with isolating bacteriophages from soil can be implemented and scaled in two-year college microbiology courses.
This project does community-based research on soil lead and arsenic contamination from brownfields, air temperature, and water pollution.
This project studies how force and a switch from sugar to fat as energy source make lab-grown heart muscle more like adult heart muscle.
This project studies how DNA methylation, small chemical additions to DNA, and bacterial evolution influence each other in Escherichia coli.
This project builds a mathematical framework so a human and a robot can learn from each other while balancing a robotic bicycle in urgent tasks.
This project studies how living in cities changes the evolution of the spotted lanternfly as it spreads, using genomic sequencing and common garden experiments.
This project designs soft materials using molecular codes that instruct automated synthesis of polymer networks with tailored combinations of properties.
This project studies how the tiny structure of cartilage relates to how it works under forces, using magnetic resonance imaging and computational simulations.
This project builds cameras for telescopes that detect very-high-energy gamma rays from sources such as black holes and supernova explosion remnants.
This project builds software that lets emergency responders and unmanned vehicles use artificial intelligence on nearby devices to find survivors in natural disasters.
This project builds mathematical models and computer simulations for systems of many interacting particles that are not in equilibrium.
This project studies how a small RNA controls cell division in sea urchin embryos and mammalian cells.
This project looks at how AI can detect vulnerabilities in systems and how to keep AI agents secure.
This project carries out research in many fields of physics, including biophysics, plasma physics, nuclear physics and quantum information science.
